safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with a left-sided headache that began upon waking today.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes headache on waking and one-sided (chief-001, hpi-001, hpi-003) but do not specify it is LEFT-sided as in the Gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the laterality (left-sided) removes a potentially useful descriptor for differentiating headache syndromes (e.g., migraine/cluster) and tracking evolution, but the note still captures key features (acute onset on waking, one-sided). This is unlikely to directly change urgent management on its own.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No statement about neck stiffness appears in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Neck stiffness is a key red-flag symptom for meningitis and can be relevant in subarachnoid hemorrhage evaluation; failure to document its absence can weaken safety-netting and risk stratification. While the patient denied it, the omission could contribute to delayed recognition/escalation if the record is relied upon.
